title: Samples
purpose: Find received samples across clients and projects, then open their receipt observations, requested tests and custody history.
summary: Every received sample across clients and projects. Open one for its receipt observations, requested tests and custody history.

tasks.title: Find a sample
steps: Type a lab ID, client sample ID, client, project, reference or location in [[Search]].
Select [[Apply]], then select the Lab ID to open the sample.

tasks.title: Find samples waiting for a decision
List what arrived in a date range
steps: Open [[More filters]], set [[Received from]] and [[Received to]], then select [[Apply]].

tasks.title: Receive new samples
steps: Select [[Receive samples]]. A new chain of custody opens; receive each sample on it.

good_to_know: Disposition is the receipt decision. It is separate from where the analytical work stands.
Search does not look at the collector's name.
Received dates use the laboratory's time zone, and both ends are included.

items.label: Search
items.description: Matches laboratory ID, client sample ID, client, project, chain-of-custody reference, collection location or current location. Collector is displayed but is not searched.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Water, Wastewater or Soil; blank includes all.

items.label: Disposition
items.description: Proceed, Qualify, Hold or Reject; blank includes all.

items.label: Client / Project
items.description: More filters: exact records, including inactive records. A selected project must belong to the selected client.

items.label: Sample type
items.description: More filters: All sample types, Field sample, Field duplicate, Field blank, Trip blank or Equipment / rinsate blank.

items.label: Sample source
items.description: More filters: All sources or one source (Drinking water, Groundwater, Surface water, Stormwater, Wastewater influent, Wastewater effluent, Industrial wastewater, Soil, Sediment, Sludge / biosolids, Solid waste). The filter does not require a matching matrix, so a source and matrix that do not fit together simply match nothing.

items.label: Received from / Received to
items.description: More filters: inclusive receipt dates in the configured laboratory time zone.

items.label: Collected from / Collected to
items.description: More filters: inclusive collection/composite-end dates in the laboratory time zone. End dates cannot precede start dates.

items.label: Receive samples
items.description: Custodians, project managers and administrators open New chain of custody, then receive its samples.

items.label: Lab ID row link
items.description: Opens the received sample’s record.

items.label: Chain of custody link
items.description: Optional column link opens its order.

sections.title: Columns
paragraphs: Columns appear in this order by default; Collection location and Collector start hidden. Your saved column layout is reset once, because the default columns changed.

items.label: Lab ID
items.description: System-assigned accession identifying this physical sample; it stays visible.

items.label: Disposition
items.description: Current receipt decision, separate from analytical work status.

items.label: Client sample ID
items.description: Identifier supplied by the client.

items.label: Client / project
items.description: Ownership derived from the sample’s chain of custody: the client, with the project beneath it. Long names are shortened; hover over the cell for the full client and project. Sorts by client.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Recorded sample matrix, with the sample source beneath it when recorded.

items.label: Type
items.description: Sample type (Field sample, Field duplicate, Field blank, Trip blank or Equipment / rinsate blank). Sortable.

items.label: Collected
items.description: Grab collection time or composite end.

items.label: Received
items.description: Receipt time; default sort is newest receipt first.

items.label: Location
items.description: Current location from receipt/custody.

items.label: Chain of custody
items.description: Reference of the sample’s chain of custody; it links to that order. Sortable.

items.label: Collection location
items.description: Initially hidden collection place, or a dash when absent.

items.label: Collector
items.description: Initially hidden person who collected the sample; this column has no sort link.

sections.title: Table controls
paragraphs: Staff with a laboratory role can read the list; client portal users cannot. Invalid criteria show errors and no rows, rather than silently widening the search. Invalid page sizes are refused. Clear filters or correct errors to continue.

items.label: Apply
items.description: Search is case-insensitive contained text; Apply combines search and filters over the full dataset and returns to page 1.

items.label: More filters
items.description: Opens advanced criteria and remains open when they are active or invalid.

items.label: Clear all / filter chips
items.description: Clear all restores the unfiltered URL and default sort. Removing a chip clears just that criterion and starts at page 1.

items.label: Column headings and Columns
items.description: Linked headings sort the complete matching set, with record ID breaking ties. Columns controls optional visibility and order, saved for your account; reset restores default presentation. Identifying columns stay visible.

items.label: Rows per page / Show
items.description: Choose 25, 50 or 100 rows, default 25. Size changes return to page 1. Show is the fallback when automatic submission is unavailable.

items.label: Pagination
items.description: First, Previous, Next and Last retain search, filters and sort; counts describe matching records.

sections.title: Empty states
paragraphs: No samples received yet means receipt has not created any records. Use Receive samples if your role permits. No samples match these filters means widen dates, check the ID or clear filters.

items.label: Column checkboxes
items.description: Changes apply immediately. Check to show an optional column or uncheck to hide it. Always shown columns are fixed.

items.label: Move column up / down
items.description: Moves an optional column within the displayed order; the first/last position disables the unavailable move. You can also drag movable table headers.

items.label: Reset columns
items.description: Restores this table’s default order and visibility for your account.

items.label: Done / Close
items.description: Closes the dialog; layout changes have already been applied and saved locally. No laboratory record is changed.
